title: Magical Peru
short_description: Lima – Cusco – Qoricancha – Sacsayhuamán – Sacred Valley – Machu Picchu – Rainbow Mountain – Humantay Lake.
long_description: Explore Peru on a complete journey that blends history, nature and culture. Start in Lima and continue to Cusco, the historical capital of the Inca Empire.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets and professional guide.
seo_title: Magical Peru 9D/8N – Lima, Cusco, Machu Picchu & Top Highlights | GT Peru Travel
seo_description: Magical Peru 9 days: Lima, Paracas, Ica, Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain. Full tour with tickets, transfers and professional guide.
seo_keywords: magical peru, peru tour 9 days, travel lima cusco machu picchu, complete peru tour, sacred valley, rainbow mountain, humantay lake, gt peru travel

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
days.text: Airport pick-up and transfer to your hotel. Check-in from 2:00 PM. If you arrive early, you may take an optional City Tour in Lima. Overnight in the capital.

days.title: Day 2: Paracas + Ballestas Islands + Ica + Huacachina
days.text: Early trip to Paracas to visit the Ballestas Islands and observe marine wildlife. Continue to Ica for a vineyard tour with wine and pisco tasting. Visit the Huacachina Oasis and enjoy dune buggies and sandboarding. Return to Lima at night.

days.title: Day 3: Flight Lima – Cusco
days.text: Transfer to the airport and flight to Cusco. Pick-up and transfer to your hotel. Free afternoon to acclimatize or attend a traditional dance show at the Qosqo Center of Native Art.

days.title: Day 4: City Tour + Abode of the Gods
days.text: Visit Qoricancha, Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo and the Abode of the Gods. Discover Inca architecture, Andean art and panoramic viewpoints.

days.title: Day 5: Machu Picchu
days.text: Train to Aguas Calientes and bus ride to Machu Picchu. Guided visit through the most important temples and viewpoints. Free time, then return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 6: Humantay Lake
days.text: Early departure to Mollepata for breakfast, followed by a hike to Humantay Lake (4200 m). Time for photos and rest. Lunch in Mollepata and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 7: Free Day
days.text: Enjoy Cusco at your own pace or take optional activities such as San Blas, San Pedro Market, museums, or a tour to Maras & Moray.

days.title: Day 8: Rainbow Mountain
days.text: Trip to Cusipata, breakfast and hike to Vinicunca (5036 m). Enjoy its unique colors and views of Ausangate Mountain. Lunch and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 9: Departure
days.text: Transfer to the airport according to your flight schedule. End of the trip.
